newsitem.title: USA: Mass. $685 mln bond bill heads to joint committee.
newsitem.headline: Mass. $685 mln bond bill heads to joint committee.

text.p: A measure authorizing the issuance of issue $685 million of general obligation debt for courthouse repairs heads to a joint legislative committee next week after the Massachusetts Senate approved the measure late Thursday.

The Senate unanimously passed the measure, which authorizes new facilites for Falmouth, Pittsfield, New Bedford, Belchertown, Dedham and Worcester and for Middlesex and Plymouth counties. A number of other courthouse facilities would be renovated.
The measure now heads to the legislative negotiating committee to work out differences with a version of the measure passed last week by the House of Representatives.
